verdict.label: STEP ASIDE — Oil Retreats on Ceasefire Draft; Chips Stage Sharpest Bounce Since July 17 Shock; Three Upgrade Conditions Approaching But None Cleared
verdict.headline: Chip rally and easing oil signal relief before Alphabet and Tesla deliver their earnings
verdict.horizon: 48 hours — through July 22 AMC triple binary (GOOGL + TSLA + AMD AI Day)
verdict.rationale_short: Brent crude pulled back to ~$88.01 (from Monday's $90.32 print) and WTI fell to $82.29 after mediators submitted a formal written 10-day ceasefire proposal — the most substantive de-escalation text yet in the US-Iran conflict, now in its 10th consecutive night of strikes. The chip complex is staging its largest single-session rebound since the Kimi K3 shock: SOXQ +4.27% premarket, AMD +4% on a Rosenblatt Top Pick upgrade ($490→$665 PT), NVDA, MU, and AVGO all higher. S&P futures +0.45% (SPY premarket $746.28, +0.56%), Nasdaq-100 futures +1.38%. BTC recovered to $66,195.68 at 11:01 UTC (up ~$1,775 from Monday's $64,420), with Gate 2 ($62,000) never approached through six consecutive sessions of equity stress. However, none of the three formal upgrade conditions have cleared: WTI at $82.29 (upgrade trigger: two consecutive closes below $79), SPX at 7,443.28 Monday close needs one confirmed close above 7,480, and VIX at ~18.83 remains above the 17 threshold. September cumulative hike probability is ~70% per CME FedWatch (hold probability 29.8%), above the formal 60% regime threshold. STEP ASIDE holds at medium conviction — the 48-hour upgrade clock is now ticking toward the GOOGL + TSLA + AMD AI Day quadruple binary tomorrow evening.

bear_case: Counter-thesis for upgrading to HOLD by Wednesday morning: All three formal upgrade conditions are now closer than at any prior point in the 10-day conflict. WTI at $82.29 is only $3.29 from the $79 trigger — one strong session of ceasefire-driven selling clears it. A GOOGL Cloud beat + strong Q3 guide on July 22 followed by semiconductor follow-through could put SPX above 7,480 for its first qualifying close by Thursday, with a second close potentially arriving on Thursday. The chip complex's +4% premarket move (SOXQ +4.27%, AMD +4% on the Rosenblatt Top Pick upgrade) is the largest single-session recovery since the Kimi K3 shock and is being led by AMD, which is the direct beneficiary of AI Day tomorrow. BTC at $66,195 with Gate 2 ($62,000) untested through six consecutive equity-stress sessions is the leading cross-asset indicator that institutional risk appetite has not structurally broken. GM's Q2 results today (20% historical beat rate) and 3M provide a real-economy backdrop test: a dual industrial beat alongside the pre-earnings chip rally would further narrow the gap to HOLD. Invalidation of STEP ASIDE: WTI closes below $79 AND SPX confirms above 7,480 AND VIX compresses below 17. As of Tuesday premarket, WTI at $82.29 — none of the three conditions cleared, but all three are within 24–72 hours of being tested.
